ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  360 ONE WAM LIMITED has filed a routine compliance certificate from its Registrar and Share Transfer Agent, MUFG Intime India, confirming adherence to SEBI Regulation 74(5) for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. This certifies that all share dematerialization requests were processed accurately and timely, with physical certificates cancelled and member registers updated as required. The document indicates proper administrative and regulatory compliance regarding shareholder record management, with no material impacts or red flags identified.
